requirement.summary: Create two local static presentation pages for the completed artifact replay: one English HTML page and one Simplified Chinese HTML page. Reuse the existing Agent Governance visual language, add one page-specific responsive stylesheet, and present the three-to-five-minute story through a strong hero, architecture flow, repair timeline, verified-result metric cards, evidence-gated cleanup explanation, tradeoffs, honest limitations, likely questions, and evidence links. Add reciprocal EN and Chinese switching plus navigation from README and the Markdown walkthrough. Add focused documentation tests, and update STATUS.md and the 2026-08-27 log. Keep receipt-validated evidence and execution code unchanged. Build locally only; do not host, publish, replay, commit, or push.

items: Chinese text must remain valid UTF-8 and avoid mojibake introduced by editing.
The two language pages can drift semantically unless tests protect shared evidence facts and reciprocal links.
A polished presentation must not overstate one Windows replay as portability or repeated reliability.
Repository publication and hosting require separate human authority and are excluded from this task.
The repository contains unrelated pre-existing changes that must remain preserved and unstaged.
Reviewed assumption: The existing guide.css supplies the base brand and layout primitives; one additive page stylesheet is sufficient for the focused flow, timeline, and metric presentation.
Reviewed assumption: Typography, CSS shapes, and existing local assets are sufficient; original imagery is unnecessary.
Reviewed assumption: Static HTML that opens directly from the repository and remains compatible with the existing document layout best matches the requested interview use.
Reviewed assumption: The existing Markdown walkthrough and receipt-validated evidence are the authoritative content sources.
Reviewed unknown: Actual visual rendering in every browser because explicit browser UI QA was not requested.
